reason: S1 dev predictions retain 49.57% of a clip on average versus 42.00% in accepted dev weak labels; test whether a modest fixed interval shrink improves paired dev F1.
scope: Postprocessing only, on the single arm/checkpoint selected by the original dev procedure. No prompt, parser, split, model, or evaluation metric change.
transform: Multiply each interval's duration by factor around its midpoint; keep the midpoint and segment count unchanged.
decision: Select the highest dev mean WEAK_TEACHER temporal F1 among factors; adopt a factor below 1 only if its mean gain versus factor 1 is at least 0.01 and the 80-source-group paired bootstrap 95% lower bound is above 0. Otherwise retain factor 1.
holdout_use: Exactly one evaluation of the selected factor; never choose or revise the factor from holdout results.
test_use: Apply the selected factor mechanically to each locally inferred interval before converting to source frame indices; no manual review.
